page_text: This site ships 106 kB First Load JS against a 120 kB budget. The content audit loop (in loop/audit.py) fetches pages, grades them against loop/rubric.md, and writes trend data to history/scores.jsonl. Every claim resolves to an id in content/editorial/ledger.yaml. You can verify all of this by cloning the repo.
rationale: Every number is verifiable. Shows the machinery. Unique claims (JS budget discipline, ledger system, runnable audit). Not problem-first but truth-dense.
